title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (November, 2026)
summary: Lists the November 2026 cumulative updates for Business Central: BC29 CU01 (29.1) for cloud and on-premises, BC28 CU07 and BC27 CU13, with application and platform build numbers. BC26 CU18 and all older versions back to BC13 are marked end of life, and lifecycle tables give the start and end dates for each release.
key_points: BC29 CU01 (29.1) ships for SaaS and on-premises on platform 29.0.57431 with application build 29.1.57497
BC28 CU07 (28.7.57329) and BC27 CU13 (27.13.57301) are the current updates for the 2026 wave 1 and 2025 wave 2 releases
BC26 CU18 is marked end of life, as are BC25 back to BC13
Under the Modern Policy, version 29.x is supported from Sep 30, 2026 to Apr 5, 2028; 28.x ends Oct 13, 2027 and 27.x ends Apr 6, 2027

quotes.text: Cumulative Update (November, 2026) for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is now released.
quotes.why_it_matters: States the primary event and timing of the update release
